The Miner's Cabin data set contains seven (7) registered 3D scans collected on the 14th of April 2016. This data set was collected as a test subject for the Digitally Preserving Alberta's Diverse Cultural Heritage Project. The cabin was captured with the Z+F 5010X scanner and processed using Z+F Laser Control software v.8.9.0.
